"The Price is Right™" is near the start of its run, with about three-quarters of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, tickets are selling faster than top prizes are being claimed, which is good for the tickets that are left.

Every line of The Price is Right™'s prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2774.headline: Tickets sold so far

2775.body:
"Casino 7s" has four of four top prizes left and is early in its run. About a quarter of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, the top prizes are being claimed more slowly than the tickets are selling, which is a good sign.

The table below shows the full count for "Casino 7s", with every prize level included.
2775.headline: How much has sold

2776.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "Patriotic Payout", most are still unsold. The game is near the start of its run, with eight of eight top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

Tomorrow's count on "Patriotic Payout" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
2776.headline: Where this game is in its run

2779.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "Gnome for the Holidays", nearly all are still unsold. The game is near the start of its run, with 56 of 57 top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

If "Gnome for the Holidays" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
2779.headline: Tickets sold so far

2780.body:
"Holiday Countdown" has joined the Texas lineup at $5 with five top prizes of $100,000. Only on the first day do the printed odds describe the game exactly, because nothing has been won. Starting tomorrow, this page shows how that changes.

If you play "Holiday Countdown" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2780.headline: New game, all prizes left

2781.body:
"The Perfect Gift" is new from the Texas Lottery. It is a $10 game with five top prizes of $250,000. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

Tomorrow's count on "The Perfect Gift" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
2781.headline: Brand new, no claims yet

2782.body:
The prize money on "$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" leans toward small, frequent prizes. It is spread over eight prize levels, from wins equal to the ticket price up to $1 million. Games built like this pay out often, in small amounts. That design never changes, and it is the part you choose.

Expect the numbers on "$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" to move around for the first few weeks as early winners claim prizes. That is normal for a new game.

If you play "$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
